sub_graphs.title: EIP-107: Read-Only RPC via Iframe

nodes.label: Receive RPC Request
nodes.description: Iframe receives RPC request message from parent window

nodes.description: Requested method is in the allowedMethods list

nodes.description: Send response back to parent window via postMessage

sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules for transaction parameters before authorization

nodes.label: Transaction Parameters Received
nodes.description: eth_sendTransaction request received with parameters

ambiguities.text: The specification mentions 43 read-only RPC methods in allowedMethods but does not enumerate all 43 methods explicitly.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume allowedMethods includes standard read-only methods like eth_blockNumber, eth_getBalance, eth_call, net_version, etc. The exact list should be verified against implementation.

ambiguities.text: The 3-second temporary unlock duration for account is mentioned but the behavior after timeout is not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume account automatically re-locks after 3 seconds, and any pending operations requiring the unlocked account will fail if not completed within the window.

ambiguities.text: eth_sign is 'explicitly prohibited' but the reason and enforcement mechanism are not detailed.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume eth_sign is blocked because it can sign arbitrary data that could be replay-attacked. Enforcement is via the authorization.html rejecting such requests.

implicit_assumptions.description: The browser's same-origin policy correctly enforces domain isolation and prevents cross-origin attacks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious dapps could read/intercept transaction data or authorization state from other origins, enabling transaction hijacking.

implicit_assumptions.description: The user's Ethereum node is running locally and accessible via the specified RPC endpoint.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: The entire authorization mechanism fails if no local node is available, preventing any dapp interaction.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot spoof or overlay the authorization popup to trick users into approving malicious transactions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: UI spoofing attacks could lead users to approve transactions with different parameters than displayed (address substitution, amount manipulation).

implicit_assumptions.description: The authorization.html file served by the node is authentic and has not been tampered with.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A compromised authorization.html could bypass all security checks, auto-approve transactions, or exfiltrate private keys.
